newsitem.title: GREECE: ALPHA FINANCE COORDINATES HALKOR'S BLOCK TRADE.
newsitem.headline: ALPHA FINANCE COORDINATES HALKOR'S BLOCK TRADE.

text.p: A block of 2.0 million shares of metallurgical firm Halcor was placed at 2,200 drachmas with foreign and local institutionals on Friday, block trade coordinator Alpha Finance said in a statement.
The shares were placed through Alpha Brokerage, Telesis Securities, National Securities and Hermes Securities, it said.
"The placement increases significantly the free float of the stock and the proceeds will be applied toward the capital increase," Alpha Finance said.
Halkor is currently going through a 4.38 billion drachma rights issue of two shares per 21 outstanding at 1,800 drachmas each.
Alpha Finance has acted as Halcor's advisor for its recent merger with Vector SA and the rights issue. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
